relationships.subject: ACC layer 5 SC neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Indeed, activation of ACC-vlPAG connections by CNO injection led to a significant decrease in mechanical hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: ACC layer 5 SC neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Counterintuitively, increased neuronal excitability was antinociceptive.

key_findings: Layer 5 ACC pyramidal neurons divide into IT and SC-projecting subtypes with distinct morphology and physiology.
Increased excitability of PAG-projecting SC neurons, induced by repeated noxious conditioning or chemogenetics, is antinociceptive.
